title: HL7-PET Scanner Conformance Vector
description: Schema for a single message-scanner conformance vector, as defined by spec 005-message-scanner FR-010. Distinct vector family from spec 001's path-* and spec 002's hier-* vectors (spec 003 FR-007 extensibility) since it exercises scan() (offsets/errors) rather than PATH evaluation. Consumed programmatically by fixtures/scripts/validate_corpus.py once registered there, and by crates/core/tests/scanner_vectors.rs. Promoted directly into fixtures/vectors/scanner/ per spec 003 FR-008 (no per-spec vectors/ copy).

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this vector within the whole corpus, e.g. "scan-001". Distinct namespace from path-* and hier-* ids.

message_ref.description: Relative path (from fixtures/) to the synthetic source HL7 message file this vector scans. MUST point to a message satisfying spec 001 FR-009 (no real patient data).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this vector demonstrates, e.g. "non-standard field separator (#)" or "truncated MSH-2".

expected_delimiters.description: Present on success vectors only. The DelimiterSet the scanner MUST resolve from this message's own MSH-1/MSH-2 (data-model.md DelimiterSet), each given as the literal single character.

expected_segments.description: Present on success vectors only. One entry per segment, in message order, giving its byte offset span (data-model.md SegmentSpan). Offsets are 0-based byte offsets into message_ref's file content.

expected_delimiter_occurrences.description: Optional even on success vectors — full occurrence-list assertions are only required for the vector(s) specifically targeting DelimiterOccurrence correctness (spec.md User Story 1 Acceptance Scenario 2); most vectors only need expected_segments/expected_delimiters. Ascending offset order (data-model.md).

expected_error.description: Present on malformed-MSH vectors only, mutually exclusive with the expected_* success fields (see allOf below). Mirrors data-model.md's ScanError.

segment_index.description: Required when kind is UnrecognizedSegment (data-model.md); absent otherwise.
